turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
An answer today. So do I, and I asked first.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admits what, and on what evidence? Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern puts nothing in his record. I'm writing that down, Hale, and the principal hears it today.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
No. Show me what you have.
